elaine: Quick design pass on the trace drilldown. A few practical things that came up from support and a11y review. kyle: fire away. elaine: 1) export action is too generic. Users asked: are we exporting the whole session, just the visible spans, or a flattened table? Recommend renaming to "Export trace (options)" and show a small chevron. nina: +1. Could we show a compact export preview modal when choosing CSV so folks see column mapping? saves support tickets. sam: Preview modal is nice but could block quick workflows. Make it optional: a checkbox "Show preview before download" persisted per user. elaine: Good call. Also: add an inline help line: "Note: CSV will flatten nested spans; use JSON for full fidelity." under the format list. kyle: Accessibility: the export dropdown currently fails keyboard tests on VoiceOver. Need role=menu + proper focus trapping. Also ensure Escape closes menu and focus returns to the export button. nina: For the CSV filename, include trace id and short timestamp, e.g. redwood_trace_abc123_20250314.csv. That helps people organize downloads. sam: UX copy: correlation id label in the timeline reads "corr id" which feels casual. Change to "Correlation ID" and make the value selectable. Add a small copy icon that only appears on hover or focus. elaine: Also request from platform: make correlation id accessible to screen readers as "Correlation ID: abc123" via aria-label. kyle: On stack frames, long paths are truncating with overflow:hidden. Keyboard users can't discover full path. Proposal: keep one-line layout visually, but make each frame row focusable and expose full path in a visually-hidden element (sr-only) and also offer a "details" expansion when focused (Enter). nina: When expanding groups of frames (e.g., collapsed library frames), announce the number of frames expanded with aria-live polite. Right now NVDA reports nothing. sam: We should also move focus into the expanded content (to the first frame) so keyboard users can continue scanning. Don't leave focus stuck on the toggler. elaine: Good pattern snippet for eng: ``` /very/long/path/to/file.ts:345
3 frames expanded
``` kyle: One more: search within trace. Support asked for searching function names and file names across the trace. Add a scoped search input with a shortcut (Ctrl/Cmd+K) that focuses it. Make it clear in the help that it only searches the current trace, not the whole app. nina: Ctrl/Cmd+K is used elsewhere for global quick open. Maybe use Ctrl/Cmd+F for trace-search but allow users to remap or disable (some folks prefer browser find). sam: If we intercept Cmd/Ctrl+F, ensure we still allow browser find when user presses Escape or an explicit "Use browser find" link. elaine: Telemetry: track export format selected and whether preview modal was shown. Add an event: trace_export { format: json|csv|har, preview_shown: true|false }. We can attach trace id hashed. kyle: Also ensure the export menu items are marked with aria-checked when format is the default (use menuitemradio pattern) so screen readers know which format is selected. nina: Small copy tweak for frame action: currently "Open in source". People misread it. Change to "Open in repo" and add a tooltip that explains fallback when mapping isn't set up. sam: Visual prod note: add a subtle chip for "user code" vs "third-party" so scanners can find likely root causes faster. Keep contrast >= 4.5:1. elaine: I'll draft the UX copy and the export modal mock. Posting PR to ui repo later today and will include keyboard interaction notes. dev-bot: Reminder: design review tomorrow 10:30 — adding this thread to the agenda. :spiral_calendar_pad: kyle: Great, thanks. I'll pair with QA on the VoiceOver checks once PR lands. nina: I'll prepare the a11y checklist and suggested aria strings. sam: I'll add telemetry ticket to the backlog. elaine: Thanks all — aiming to ship this in the next minor.
